name: Coffee Pub Monarch
tagline: Save module sets and back up world settings.
description: Saves the set of enabled Foundry modules as named, color-coded configurations you can switch between, export and import. Also provides JSON backup and restore of world settings, jump-to-setting search and pruning of orphaned settings. The only module that works without Blacksmith.
pitch: Save your enabled modules as named sets and switch between them in one click, with backup and restore for world settings.

features.title: Named module sets
features.text: Save enabled modules under a name and load with one click; color coding previews what turns on and off.

features.title: Export and import sets
features.text: Move module-set configurations between worlds or machines as files.

features.title: Settings backup
features.text: Back up all world settings to JSON and restore with a preview where you choose which modules to restore.

features.title: World vs personal
features.text: On import, world settings are separated from personal settings so UI preferences do not carry over.

features.title: Jump to setting
features.text: Search any setting by name; the list scrolls to the match instead of hiding other settings.

features.title: Prune orphaned settings
features.text: Clear settings left behind by uninstalled modules (read the pruning guide first).

steps: In Foundry, go to Add-on Modules, Install Module, and paste the manifest URL.
Open your world, go to Manage Modules, and enable Monarch.
Save your enabled modules as a named set; export your settings and module sets to files first as a safety backup.
needs: GM access for module set features

gallery.caption: Settings import preview
gallery.title: Choose what to import
gallery.text: Importing a settings file opens a preview with every module listed and checked. Untick any you do not want, or use Select All and Select None, then proceed with the import.

gallery.caption: Settings import result
gallery.title: See what came across
gallery.text: When the import finishes you get a summary: how many settings were imported, how many were world or client scoped, how many you skipped by choice, and any that failed. A reload applies the changes.

gallery.caption: Jump to a setting by name
gallery.title: Jump to a setting
gallery.text: Type a name in the search box and the settings list scrolls to the match instead of hiding everything else. The counts beside each module show how many settings it holds.

gallery.caption: Prune orphaned settings
gallery.title: Find leftover settings
gallery.text: The prune report lists every module namespace and marks the ones whose module is no longer installed. Orphaned settings are pre-checked, with a warning that pruning cannot be undone, so back up first.
